title: National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic (Národný štipendijný program SR, NŠP)
degree: Not applicable (mobility scholarship for study, research or artistic stays; no degree is awarded)
official_source: National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic, administered by SAIA (Slovak Academic and Information Agency) under an agreement with the Ministry of Education, Research, Development and Youth of the Slovak Republic
duration: Length of the approved study, research or artistic stay abroad or, for the incoming track, in Slovakia
description: The National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic, established by the Slovak government in 2005 and financed by the Ministry of Education, Research, Development and Youth from the state budget, supports mobility of students, doctoral candidates, university teachers, research and artistic workers. Administered by SAIA, n.o., it funds living costs for study, research or artistic stays abroad (outgoing track) or in Slovakia (incoming track), with a distance-based travel grant.

title: GETFund Postgraduate Foreign Scholarship (Ghana Education Trust Fund)
duration: Duration of the postgraduate programme abroad
description: The Ghana Education Trust Fund's postgraduate foreign scholarship supports Ghanaians studying at postgraduate level outside Ghana, with financial support covering tuition fees, accommodation and scholastic materials. GETFund describes its programme as financial, social and academic support with priority given to STEM programmes and to female education, and it also funds capacity building, faculty development through the Ghana Tertiary Education Commission and short courses abroad. Applications for the 2026/2027 postgraduate foreign scholarships opened on 13 April 2026 and closed on 30 April 20

title: Pacific Scholarship for Excellence in Research & Innovation (PSERI)
official_source: The University of the South Pacific (USP)
duration: Master's: 18 months for applicants who have completed a Postgraduate Diploma, 24 months for applicants with an Undergraduate Degree only. PhD: 36 months.
description: The Pacific Scholarship for Excellence in Research & Innovation (PSERI) is a USP Research Office scholarship inviting applications from suitably qualified candidates to undertake a Masters degree or Doctor of Philosophy by research only at The University of the South Pacific. Awards are tenable from early 2026 and may be held in any member country of the USP, with the University keen to fund interdisciplinary projects that fall within its Strategic Research Themes.

title: Scholarships for High Achievers Higher Education (Level 7) Overseas Scheme (TSLS, Government of Fiji)
official_source: Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service (TSLS), Ministry of Education, Government of Fiji
program_type: Government scholarship (Fiji Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service statutory scheme)
duration: Not published on the scheme page; the TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook covers this
description: A TSLS statutory scheme listed on the Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service schemes page as the High Achievers Higher Education (Level 7) Overseas Scheme, advertised for Fiji citizens who completed Year 13 with 340/400 or above and who hold a final offer from a listed Australian or New Zealand university in a priority discipline. The scheme's own page is currently unavailable and it is not listed among the schemes in TSLS's 2027 Scholarship Policies Handbook for the 2026-2027 Financial Year.

title: Toloa Tertiary Scholarship (Toloa Scholarships - tertiary stream, Ministry for Pacific Peoples)
degree: Tertiary (second year and beyond of a full-time STEM degree)
official_source: Ministry for Pacific Peoples, New Zealand Government
program_type: Government scholarship (funded by the Ministry for Pacific Peoples, administered by Le Va)
description: The Toloa Tertiary Scholarship supports Pacific students in New Zealand who are in the second year or beyond of a full-time STEM degree. The Ministry for Pacific Peoples funds it and Le Va administers applications, disbursement and reporting, and up to NZD 10,000 for one year of full-time study is paid directly to the institution. Applications for the 2026 round closed at 5pm on 9 February 2026, and students in their final year or Year 3 of STEM study are excluded because they can access the Government fees-free programme.

title: Pacific Regional Sports Research Scholarship (PRSRS)
official_source: Oceania National Olympic Committee and The University of the South Pacific
program_type: Joint research scholarship (Oceania National Olympic Committee with the University of the South Pacific)
duration: One year of full-time Master's by research study plus a semester of teaching contribution and a semester of industry placement, terms agreed on confirmation of award
description: The Pacific Regional Sports Research Scholarship (PRSRS) is a collaboration between the Oceania National Olympic Committee and The University of the South Pacific, inviting applications for a Master's by research degree at USP on interdisciplinary projects within economics, social impact or physical education with a focus on sports. Awards are tenable from early 2026 and may be held in any member country of the USP.

title: Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scholarships Scheme with Australian Universities (TSLS, Government of Fiji)
official_source: Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service (TSLS), Ministry of Education, Government of Fiji
program_type: Government scholarship (Fiji Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service statutory scheme)
duration: Not published on the scheme page; the TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook covers this
description: The Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scheme is a TSLS scholarship, revamped to partially support Fiji citizens undertaking full-time PhD study at ten eligible universities in Australia. Under the cost-sharing arrangement the tuition fee is borne by the partner university in Australia or New Zealand, while TSLS provides a living allowance, airfare, visa and health cover support and other allowances. Five awards are available for the 2026-2027 Financial Year.
